Name: DietMatrix
Description: Table 4: All rows are preys and all columns are predators. The numbers in the column headings correspond to the number in the row headings. So this table shows per column (predator) the diet composition (in percentages) of the prey (rows) items.

Name: VulnerabilityMatrix
Description: Table 5: The rows represent the preys and functional group number and the columns represent the predators by functional group number. The values represent the vulnerability of that prey functional group to the predator. A high value represents a top-down control and a low value represents a bottom-up control.
